about_the_game:
Day X is an immersive, interactive fiction adventure told in a gripping graphic novel style. Step into the boots of Jason Miller, a Navy SEAL caught in the chaos of a nuclear strike on the United States—just as a deadly bioweapon is unleashed, turning men into flesh-eating monsters.

As the story unfolds, you control the narrative—every decision you make shapes your path. Choose wisely, as your actions can unlock new storylines, forge unexpected alliances, or lead you to a sudden, deadly end.

With multiple branching storylines, life-and-death decisions, and several unique endings, this is more than just a story—it's your own gripping, choose-your-own-adventure. Read, decide, and survive.

content_descriptors.notes: There are depictions of people being shot. Zombies. Depictions of cartoon/comic bodies.
